text: I'm really enjoying this game! it's a little like the other board games out there but with a coin master twist. It looks like there are lots of events you can get into but I am not advanced enough levels to play them yet. the only problem I have is that I can't seem to connect to Facebook? when I tap the connect button it comes up with a Meta cookies request that I cannot scroll to the bottom of.

This is a really good game, especially for families to play together. A cross between Coin Master and Monopoly, who could ask for anything better. I love the graphics a lot. The only thing I do have a small niggle about is the cost of rebuilding ruined villages. I have only reached village 5, and already it is costing in the millions of coins to build some of the village features. To have to pay that again after an attack is a bit unfair, I think personally. But all in all, it's a great game.

Visually cute, but just RNG with no actual skills required. So many events running at one time that you have to close down about 10 pop up notifications each time you log in and to play properly you really need to be able to play in short bursts throughout the day. If that is the sort of game you are looking for, then this is one of the best of that type. Not to my tastes though, I just found it boring
